spec.claim_summary: Daily dollar-cost averaging into Bitcoin outperforms waiting to buy only on dips greater than 5% from the recent high.
spec.untestable_reason: Rule requires a $1-per-day DCA accumulation ladder with overlapping positions and no single-trade exit, which cannot be reduced to a one-position entry/exit rule.
assumptions: Most recent high interpreted as previous 365-bar highest high; claim gives no lookback.
Dip greater than 5% encoded as close more than 5% below that high (multiplier 0.95).
Timeframe 1d taken from page chart context, not claimant words.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: $1-per-day DCA ladder / portfolio accumulation with multiple overlapping positions and cash sizing; engine tests one position at a time.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: no exit / holding period is stated; dip-buy portfolio is buy-and-hold to 2021-05-23.

evidence.quote: Don't Buy Until There's a Dip Greater Than 5% from the Most Recent High Price
every day from May 1, 2013 until May 23, 2021

audit_majors: testable: Mechanical core is testable: buy BTC when price is >5% below most recent high on 1d. $1-sizing / overlapping DCA ladder and buy-and-hold to 2021-05-23 are position-size / test-window issues which per scope do not make a claim untestable, so testable=false with reason of overlapping positions/no single exit does not hold.
